name: Docsvault
description_en: Docsvault is an on-premise document and email management system from Easy Data Access. It connects files with structured profiles, access rules, versions and routed tasks; its current presentation emphasizes matter-centric work for legal and other document-heavy teams. Desktop, web and mobile access depend on the deployed server components. On-premise operation is separate from subscription entitlement and from optional AI processing.
description_zh: Docsvault 是 Easy Data Access 的本地部署文档及邮件管理系统，将文件与结构化资料、访问规则、版本及流转任务结合。当前官网强调法律及其他文档密集团队按案件组织工作。桌面、网页及移动访问依赖所部署服务器组件。本地运行、订阅权益和可选 AI 处理是不同问题。

core_features.explanation_zh: 选定索引字段可在导入前设为必填。

core_features.explanation_en: An explicit user entry takes precedence over that user’s group entries on an item.
core_features.explanation_zh: 项目中明确的用户条目优先于其组条目。

core_features.explanation_en: Assigned users can initiate manually; new folder documents or assigned profiles can trigger workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 指定用户可手动启动，新入文件夹文档或分配资料类型也可触发流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Full/incremental backups and standard-folder exports serve different recovery and access needs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 完整或增量备份与标准文件夹导出对应不同恢复和访问需要。

en: Evaluate a synthetic vendor contract from mandatory indexing through review, sharing and portable exit.
zh: 评估虚构供应商合同从必填索引到审查、共享及便携退出。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation only; not customer adoption or measured performance.

Deployment.en: On-premise Windows/.NET and SQL FILESTREAM repository; separate web components and HTTPS mobile access.
Deployment.zh: 本地 Windows/.NET 及 SQL FILESTREAM 资料库；独立网页组件与 HTTPS 移动访问。

steps.zh: 确认部署版本运行环境、用户组合和所需模块，再评估虚构合同的索引、权限及恢复路径。

official_check.scope: Public primary-source documentation; no account operation, purchase, benchmark, owner verification or publishing approval.

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Make the record identifiable before routing it
sections.title_zh: 流转前先让记录可辨认
sections.en:
Docsvault combines document and email storage with profiles, versions and tasks. A cabinet or folder locates a file, while a profile adds structured business identifiers. Required index fields can stop an import with missing values, but they do not prove the supplied value belongs to the correct matter.

For an editorial evaluation, create a synthetic vendor contract with vendor ID, contract number, effective date and document type. Import a second revision and an associated email using the same intended record context. Ask a reviewer to find the current agreement by identifier and verify the source, rather than relying on a filename or OCR hit. Include a deliberately incorrect but nonempty identifier to test human or external validation. No record, message or import was created.
sections.zh:
Docsvault 将文档和邮件存储与资料字段、版本及任务结合。资料柜或文件夹定位文件，资料字段补充结构化业务标识。必填索引可阻止缺值导入，却不证明所填值属于正确案件。

编辑建议的评估可用虚构供应商合同，设供应商标识、合同号、生效日及文档类型。用相同预期记录背景导入另一修订及相关邮件。让审查者按标识找到当前协议并核对来源，不只依赖文件名或 OCR 命中。应包含故意错误但非空的标识，以检查人工或外部验证。本研究未创建记录、邮件或导入。

sections.title_en: Test the explicit user entry as well as group membership
sections.title_zh: 同时检查明确用户条目与组成员身份
sections.en:
The permission article says a user may belong to multiple groups, but when the item’s security table includes both the user and their group, only the user’s rights are considered for that person. Group rights are ignored in that case. It does not specify how every conflict between group-only entries is resolved. A license type and an assigned security right are also different controls.

For the synthetic contract, compare a group-only reviewer with a reviewer who also has an explicit item entry. Exercise list, read, edit and export separately in the intended client. Then inspect a newly filed document rather than assuming it inherits the expected behavior. Read-only licenses can expose internal notes, profiles and tasks within permitted access, whereas external users have a different sharing scope. Do not turn those labels into a blanket promise of minimal exposure. No user or permission was changed.
sections.zh:
权限文章说明用户可属于多个组，但当项目安全表同时包含用户和其组时，对该人只考虑用户权限，忽略组权限。文章没有说明所有仅组条目冲突的解决方式。许可类型与所分配安全权限也是不同控制。

虚构合同评估应比较仅组授权的审查者，以及另有明确项目条目的审查者，在目标客户端分别检查列出、读取、编辑和导出。还应检查新归档文档，不能假定它继承了预期行为。只读许可可在允许访问范围内显示内部备注、资料和任务；外部用户则有不同共享范围，不能仅凭标签承诺最低暴露。本研究未更改用户或权限。

sections.title_en: A workflow step, a transition and a signature have different states
sections.title_zh: 流程步骤、转换及签署有不同状态
sections.en:
Workflow steps describe document states; transitions describe the actions and effects that move work onward. Docsvault documents manual initiation by assigned initiators, initiation when a new document enters a configured folder, and profile-based initiation. Separately, an active signature request locks the file against editing until completion or cancellation, while still allowing viewing.

For the proposed contract, define who can initiate, what a rejection means and which corrected revision should be reviewed. Check that an import invokes the intended trigger once, that a recipient can distinguish a task from a signature request, and that corrections do not silently replace a document already awaiting signature. The multi-person-step article was not readable, so quorum, parallel decisions and escalation should remain explicit evaluation questions. Exact restart and post-signature revision behavior was not established. No workflow or signature request was run; legal enforceability was not evaluated.
sections.zh:
流程步骤描述文档状态，转换描述推动工作及其影响的动作。Docsvault 文档列出指定发起人手动启动、新文档进入配置文件夹启动及按资料类型启动。另一方面，活动签署请求在完成或取消前锁定文件编辑，但仍可查看。

建议合同样例应确定谁能发起、拒绝意味着什么，以及应审查哪份修正修订。需检查一次导入是否只触发预期流程、收件人能否区分任务和签署请求，以及修正是否悄悄替换待签文件。多人步骤文章未能读取，因此人数阈值、并行决定及升级处理仍需评估。精确重启和签后修订行为未确立。本研究未运行流程或签署请求，也未评估法律效力。

sections.title_en: Restoring a file can preserve its old sharing identity
sections.title_zh: 恢复文件可能保留原共享身份
sections.en:
Docsvault’s sharing articles permit passwords and allow administrators to reset sharing options. A document request link stops accepting uploads when expired and can be reactivated by extending its expiry. Another article states that restoring a deleted item from the recycle bin maintains the original shared link. Deleting and restoring a file therefore should not be treated as a method for issuing a new sharing identity.

For the synthetic contract, record intended recipients and the permitted action before testing sharing. Review link settings after a restore, and distinguish an upload request from a download-sharing link. Confirm whether a restored link remains subject to its prior expiry and password in the actual version; that behavior was not documented in the short restore article. A password alone does not establish who holds it, and link expiry does not recall downloaded copies. No link, upload, deletion or restore was performed.
sections.zh:
Docsvault 共享文章允许设置密码，并允许管理员重置共享选项。文档请求链接过期会停止接收上传，延长到期时间可重新启用。另一文章说明，从回收站恢复已删项目会保留原共享链接，因此不能把删除再恢复当作签发新共享身份的方法。

虚构合同测试共享前，应记录目标收件人和允许动作；恢复后复核链接设置，并区分上传请求与下载共享链接。短篇恢复文章未说明旧到期时间及密码的精确保留行为，需要在实际版本确认。密码本身不能确立持有人身份，链接过期也不能收回已下载副本。本研究未执行链接、上传、删除或恢复操作。

sections.title_en: Preserve the repository as well as readable copies
sections.title_zh: 同时保留资料库与可读副本
sections.en:
The storage article separates SQL metadata tables from document files in a server FILESTREAM folder, with transfers controlled through SQL transactions. The backup article describes scheduled full or incremental backups, retention and failure alerts. It also offers repository export into standard folders. That export is useful for access outside Docsvault, but the article does not establish that it reproduces every workflow, history or permission when re-imported.

For the contract pilot, define a recovery point containing documents, metadata and security, and separately define the portable archive a user needs after leaving. Verify a representative restore and an exported file’s readability before relying on either. A backup-completed message does not establish an application can be recovered on a replacement server. Confirm credentials, keys, configuration and supported restore procedure with the deployed version. No database, filesystem, backup, export or recovery operation was attempted.
sections.zh:
存储文章区分 SQL 元数据表与服务器 FILESTREAM 文件夹中的文档，传输由 SQL 事务控制。备份文章描述计划完整或增量备份、保留规则及失败提醒，也提供导出为标准文件夹的能力。导出便于在 Docsvault 外访问，但文章未确立重新导入可重建每项流程、历史或权限。

合同试点应定义包含文档、元数据及安全设置的恢复点，并另行定义离开系统后用户需要的便携存档。依赖前应验证代表性恢复及导出文件可读性。备份完成消息不证明能在替换服务器恢复应用。应按已部署版本确认凭据、密钥、配置及受支持恢复方法。本研究未尝试数据库、文件系统、备份、导出或恢复。

sections.title_en: Do not extend on-premise claims to every AI operation
sections.title_zh: 不要将本地部署声明扩大至所有 AI 操作
sections.en:
DocAI is an optional capability layer with extraction and selected-content assistance. The current page distinguishes AI Capture from Automatic Data Capture, which uses locally configured extraction rules. It also says trusted AI services process documents, while a FAQ on the same page says content is not shared externally. These descriptions do not establish a precise provider boundary or prove every DocAI operation stays inside the customer network.

Before enabling AI for the synthetic contract, identify the provider, endpoint, selected content, processing region, retention and applicable agreement. Compare extracted identifiers with source pages and keep a correction path before filing or routing. Access permissions over stored content do not on their own describe what is transmitted to an AI processor. The vendor’s accuracy and no-retention statements were not independently audited. No DocAI license was activated, content selected, provider connected or extraction executed.
sections.zh:
DocAI 是可选能力层，包含提取及所选内容辅助。当前页面区分 AI Capture 与使用本地配置提取规则的 Automatic Data Capture；它还称文档由可信 AI 服务处理，而同页 FAQ 又称内容不向外部共享。这些说明未确立精确提供方边界，也不能证明所有 DocAI 操作均留在客户网络内。

对虚构合同启用 AI 前，应明确提供方、端点、所选内容、处理地区、保留及适用协议。提取标识需与来源页面比较，归档或流转前应保留纠正路径。存储内容的访问权限本身不描述向 AI 处理方传输什么。厂商准确率及不保留声明未经独立审计。本研究未激活 DocAI、选择内容、连接提供方或执行提取。

sections.title_en: Price the edition, user types and continued access together
sections.title_zh: 一同核对版本、用户类型和持续访问费用
sections.en:
The products page describes monthly or annual subscriptions based on edition and user type, starting with five users. Small Business, Enterprise and Ultimate have different add-on scope. Actual browser cards show contact sales without a numerical price; repeated static-reader amounts are not adopted. Named users have dedicated connections; concurrent users share a connection pool, which does not mean shared credentials.

The EULA requires cancellation at least five working days before renewal to prevent automatic renewal and provides no prorated refund for the current paid period. Its API terms require activation licensing and prohibit middleware that bypasses user licensing. Proprietary software restrictions remain separate from the Apache-licensed Tesseract component; the engine is not open source. The EULA also contains differing distribution wording, so a redistribution use case needs clarification. Quote infrastructure, user mix and optional modules together before estimating cost. A 30-day trial is advertised, but no trial or quote was requested.
sections.zh:
产品页描述按版本及用户类型每月或每年订阅，五用户起。Small Business、Enterprise 与 Ultimate 的附加模块范围不同。实际浏览器卡片显示联系销售，未显示数值价格，因此不采用读取器中的重复金额。实名用户有专用连接，并发用户共享连接池，不等于共享凭据。

EULA 要求至少在续费前五个工作日取消，以阻止自动续期；当前已付周期不按比例退款。API 条款要求激活许可，禁止通过中间层绕过用户许可。专有软件限制与 Apache 许可的 Tesseract 组件分开，引擎本身不是开源。EULA 还存在不同分发措辞，涉及再分发需澄清。估算费用应同时核对基础设施、用户组合及可选模块。官网宣传 30 天试用，但本研究未申请试用或报价。

sections.title_en: Resolve version and subscription continuity before rollout
sections.title_zh: 上线前解决版本与订阅连续性问题
sections.en:
System requirements identify a Windows/.NET server, SQL with full-text and FILESTREAM, and separate web access dependencies; mobile access requires an SSL certificate. The page’s broad list includes legacy platforms, so it is not a substitute for confirming currently supported and patched runtime versions. The homepage promotes v19 while the manual index links v18 and v17 to the same manual URL; the unversioned short knowledge articles do not prove every release behaves identically.

The support policy says a lapsed subscription restricts file access and describes 30-day data retention, despite the on-premise positioning. It does not explain deletion mechanics for customer-owned servers. Confirm read/export access at expiry, recovery arrangements and the order’s exact applicability before rollout. Website privacy terms concern contact, payment and analytics data and do not resolve repository retention. Support operates business hours, so recovery planning should not assume continuous staffed assistance. No server, subscription or support session was operated.
sections.zh:
系统要求列出 Windows/.NET 服务器、带全文和 FILESTREAM 的 SQL，以及独立网页访问依赖；移动访问需要 SSL 证书。页面宽泛列表包含旧平台，不能替代对当前受支持及已修补运行版本的确认。首页宣传 v19，但手册索引将 v18、v17 链至同一地址；未标版本的短篇知识库不证明各版行为完全一致。

虽然定位本地部署，支持政策仍称停订会限制文件访问，并描述 30 天数据保留，却未解释客户自有服务器的删除机制。上线前应确认到期读取导出权、恢复安排及精确订单适用性。网站隐私条款涉及联系、支付及分析数据，不能解决资料库保留问题。支持在工作时间运行，恢复规划不应假定全天有人值守。本研究未操作服务器、订阅或支持会话。

seo.title_en: Docsvault: Indexed Contracts, Access Rules and Subscription Continuity
seo.title_zh: Docsvault：合同索引、访问规则与订阅连续性
seo.description_en: Evaluate Docsvault on-premise document workflows with explicit user permissions, restored sharing links, backup/export scope and DocAI processing questions.
seo.description_zh: 结合明确用户权限、恢复共享链接、备份导出范围及 DocAI 处理问题，评估 Docsvault 本地文档流程。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Docsvault for controlled on-premise documents.
secondary_questions: What happens to sharing links after file restoration?
Does on-premise licensing guarantee access after subscription expiry?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no keyword-demand or ranking measurement.

research_gaps.en: No account, trial, installation, SQL operation, import, permission change, backup/export/restore, sharing, signature, AI action, API activation, quote, purchase or cancellation executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、试用、安装、SQL、导入、权限变更、备份导出恢复、共享、签署、AI、API 激活、询价、购买或取消。

research_gaps.en: Exact v19 behavior, group-only conflicts, recycle-bin purge period, full recovery/portable export fidelity, workflow quorum and AI provider/location/retention require verification. Multi-person-step article failed; manual reader exposed only navigation.
research_gaps.zh: 精确 v19 行为、仅组授权冲突、回收站清除期、完整恢复及便携导出保真、工作流人数阈值、AI 提供方地区保留需核实。多人步骤文章读取失败，手册读取器仅显示导航。

research_gaps.en: On-premise marketing does not resolve optional external AI processing or subscription-expiry retention mechanics. No numerical price adopted; performance, compliance, migration and privacy claims not independently verified.
research_gaps.zh: 本地部署营销不能解决可选外部 AI 处理或停订保留机制。未采用数值价格；性能、合规、迁移及隐私主张未经独立验证。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation; proposed examples were not executed.
